description: North Korea has highly restricted domestic media and internet access. The open-web searches relied mainly on externally reporting outlets with anonymous sources; unreported or concealed gatherings may not be discoverable. Search silence is not evidence that no protest occurred.
required_followup: Consult authorized local-language archives, independent human-rights reporting and any permitted historical baseline; preserve the gap if access is unavailable.

description: Search coverage was bounded to a small set of English/Korean queries and surfaced many South Korean demonstrations or North Korean coverage of protests in the ROK. Those actions are outside the North Korea event territory and were not coded as events here. No LexisNexis access or systematic local archive access was available.
required_followup: Conduct further week-by-week Korean-language and local/regional-source searches, checking the physical location and state target of each report.

description: No located report established a qualifying public North Korean gathering with at least 50 simultaneous people and a demand on North Korea’s own state or policy. Search-only snippets and private verbal dissatisfaction are not sufficient.
required_followup: Seek reports or contemporaneous documents that establish actual public gathering, simultaneous attendance, location, demand, onset and state response.

description: Potential internal dissent reports were not sufficient to determine event onset, duration, or cross-month continuity. The one reported Hyesan miners’ meeting occurred Oct 26 and was an internal session of roughly 10 workers, so it is excluded as subthreshold/nonpublic.
required_followup: Do not transfer a workplace session or complaint across months as a protest without evidence of a qualifying public action.

description: No eligible public protest candidate was established, so protester violence and state-response variables remain unassigned. In reports about enforcement or labor mobilization, no inference of protester violence or state response is made from silence.
required_followup: If a qualifying event is later identified, seek direct reporting on arrests, beatings, dispersal, accommodation, killings and shootings.

description: Official baseline and original historical source/review ledgers are not present in this partition; this is a bounded research snapshot and not official approval or a zero-event determination.
required_followup: Coordinator review against authorized official baseline and original historical evidence.
